sonnet.problem: This story card re-tells verse 24 (no foot care, no clean clothes, no mustache trim, the whole time the king was gone). Cards 1 and 2 already told and asked about that verse, so the card adds only a joke and no new part of the passage.

This True statement re-asks the fact card 14 just asked: in verse 30 Mephibosheth says 'let Ziba take it all', which is giving up his share. It is also a True statement that just repeats the card before it.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.

sonnet.problem: The question says Mephibosheth 'comes from Jerusalem'. That gives away the answer to stop 2 card 4, which asks where David will provide for Barzillai (Jerusalem).
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
